prompts.text: Name a bird that lives in or by water

items.quip: Males carry chicks in skin pockets under their wings, even while flying.
items.title: Sungrebe
items.extract: The sungrebe or American finfoot is a small aquatic gruiform found in the tropical and subtropical Americas from northeastern Mexico to central Ecuador and southern Brazil.

prompts.text: Name something with physical pages (named works don't count)

items.quip: Summit logbooks usually sit in weatherproof, animal-proof metal cases.
items.title: Summit register
items.description: Record of visitors to a mountain's summit
items.extract: A summit book or summit register is a record of visitors to the summit of a mountain. It is usually enclosed in a weatherproof, animal-proof metal casing. Some books are maintained in an informal manner by an individual or small group, while others are maintained by a club. Well-known and often-climbed peaks, such as those on peak bagging lists, are more likely to have summit books. On the other hand, mountains which are very heavily climbed or have popular trails up, such as Mount Whitney or Ben Nevis, may not have registers, or may have a daily logbook that is changed out often.

prompts.text: Name a type of ball outside of sports

items.quip: Greenwich's time ball, installed in 1833, still drops at 1 p.m.
items.title: Time ball
items.extract: A time ball is a large, wooden or metal ball that moves up and down a pole, and which is dropped at a predetermined time of day. Because precise timekeeping is essential to the determination of longitude at sea, time balls were principally erected to allow navigators aboard nearby ships to synchronize their marine chronometers with a reference time standard controlling the ball.

prompts.text: Name a boy band or girl group with over 500,000 monthly listeners on Spotify

items.quip: Their name combines members' first names: Monifa, Kenya and Stefanie.
items.title: MoKenStef
items.extract: MoKenStef is an American female R&B trio from Los Angeles, active from 1994 until 2000. The group name was a combination of the first syllable of each member's name: Monifa, Kenya, and Stefanie. They released an album, Azz Izz, in 1995, and their biggest hit was "He's Mine", which peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100. It also spent one week in the UK Singles Chart in September 1995 at #70. Their second single, "Sex in the Rain", was not as successful, peaking only at #41 on the US R&B chart.

prompts.text: Name a country whose flag has a white stripe down or across the middle

items.quip: Its flag's black emblem is a mokorotlo, the traditional Basotho hat.
items.title: Lesotho
items.extract: Lesotho, officially the Kingdom of Lesotho, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa. Surrounded by South Africa, it is the largest of the three sovereign, non-exclave enclaves in the world. Lesotho is located in the Maloti Mountains, with the highest peak in southern Africa. It has an area of over 30,000 km2 (11,600 mi2), with a population of about 2.3 million. Its capital and largest city is Maseru.

prompts.text: Name a one-word food or drink that starts with Ch

items.quip: A hard chhurpi block, chewed like gum, lasts up to five hours.
items.title: Chhurpi
items.extract: Chhurpi, otherwise known as durkha and chogo/chugo, is a traditional cheese consumed in Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet and parts of Northeastern India. The two varieties of chhurpi are a soft variety and a very hard variety. Chhurpi is considered one of the hardest cheeses in the world.
